operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm run verify && pnpm check:deployment-spec
operations.recovery: Follow docs/BACKUP-RESTORE.md: stop writes and scheduled work, retain exact source and private configuration, export supported D1 and FILES data, restore into empty compatible resources, re-enter private configuration and compare a fresh export before routing traffic. Preserve every applied migration name and byte.
